answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Each submission hangs on the glacier of a task receipt, and the lotus is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
